To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we developed the straightness measurement technique by detecting the slope angle, and that the aligning accuracy of the 483-m straight section of the KEK linca could be evaluated with an uncertainty of 0.3 mm, which is sufficient for the KEK e-/ e+ injector linac.

the slope angles between alignment base plates can be detected with the reproducability of 9μrad by using the electronic level Talyvel 5, and that the aligning straighness can be evaluated with the reproducabilty of 26μm by using the slope angles, which is hardly acheived by conventional methods.

the slope angles between alignment base plates could be measured with a standard deviation (σ ) of 9 μ rad using Talyvel4, and that the straightness could then be measured with a σ of 26 μ m, a result that cannot be achieved using conventional methods.

the straightness measurement method by detecting slope angle is a promising method for evaluating the straightline straightness of a long linac, and the method is applicable for the straightness evaluation for the linac of the ILC project.

The main takeaway from our work is that

the slope angles between two alignment base plates can be easily detected with high accuracy, which is hardly achievable by any other conventional method, and that the aligning-straightness can be evaluated with the accuracy of sub-mm fairly easily, by using this method.

the straightness of the linac can be evaluated with the reproducability of 0.2 mm (2σ), which is hardly achieved for the 600-m-length by conventional methods, by detecting the slope angle with Talyvel4, a precise level system.
